service.name: backdrop-studio
service.description: Design-system-aware generation of ambient hero imagery for landing pages and promotional surfaces

setup.description: Build API and UI assets declared by the manifest-driven lifecycle contract

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && GOWORK=off go mod download && GOWORK=off go build -o backdrop-studio-api .

steps.name: install-ui-deps
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm install --ignore-workspace || pnpm install --ignore-workspace); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

steps.name: build-ui
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run build || pnpm --ignore-workspace run build); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

develop.description: Launch API and Vite dev server

steps.name: start-api
steps.description: Start Go API server in background

test.description: Execute phased test suite via test-genie

steps.name: check-temporal-models
steps.description: Verify formal flow artifacts via the flow-verifier scenario CLI

steps.name: run-tests
steps.description: Run all test phases via test-genie

image-tools.name: image-tools
image-tools.description: Every raster treatment and every model inference runs here. Backdrop Studio ships no raster or provider code. ai-gateway is reached transitively through this dependency, never directly.
image-tools.degraded_behavior: The catalog, style authoring and released-backdrop surfaces stay available, but nothing renders: every treatment and every inference runs in image-tools and no local substitute is permitted. Compose still resolves and returns a plan, so the operator sees exactly what would run once the dependency returns.

brand-manager.name: brand-manager
brand-manager.description: Resolves $brand.* palette slots at render time. An unresolved slot is refused by name and never defaulted.
brand-manager.degraded_behavior: Browsing and released backdrops stay available, but no render proceeds: a $brand.* slot that cannot be resolved is refused by name and never defaulted, because a substituted colour would silently break the palette lock the treatment layer exists to provide.

asset-studio.name: asset-studio
asset-studio.description: Provenance, cost and disclosure for model-backed releases only. Procedural releases deliberately do not depend on it, so the free lanes keep working when it is unavailable.
asset-studio.degraded_behavior: Procedural and procedural-treated releases are unaffected and continue to work in full, since they incur no spend and carry no disclosure obligation. Only guided and synthesized releases are blocked, and they refuse with the dependency named.
